summary.reason_for_fail: The current files are internally consistent, but the verifier does not enforce all manifest/template and evidence-path bindings, overlay authority/scope is under-validated, incomplete finalization exits successfully, and create-only multi-artifact publication is neither exclusive nor transactional.

current_bundle_checks.evidence: The wrapper verify-queue command completed successfully for 48 rows without writing a report.
All 48 template rows exactly equal review_template(queue_row), queue IDs remain in queue order, and the current template SHA-256 equals the manifest value.
Both self-validation files currently carry the live queue and manifest hashes; v2 additionally records 48 run hashes and 48 Gold hashes verified.

verify_bundle_paths revalidates the source queue with the base scorer, preserves every base contract field except the intentionally versioned schema token, preserves row identity/order, and confirms the expected 48-row model/stage denominators.

The queue contracts bind the overlay path/hash and effective-policy hash; the effective policy makes PID identity and hidden alert mapping non-scoring and fixes canonical slots to subject/operation/object with action as an alias of operation.

findings.title: verify-queue ignores the manifest's review-template path and hash

locations.detail: bind-overlay writes review_template and review_template_sha256 into the manifest.
verify_bundle_paths validates queue, overlay, source queue, source manifest, evidence hashes, and denominators but never opens or hashes manifest.review_template.

findings.impact: A deleted, replaced, wrong-path, or hash-mismatched review template is accepted as a valid formal bundle. The same verifier also accepts false score_root, models, stage_counts, source_artifacts_modified, external_api_calls, and non_overwrite_policy manifest claims.

reproduction.method: Copy the current bound manifest to a temporary file; set review_template to a nonexistent path, review_template_sha256 to 64 zeroes, score_root/models/stage_counts to wrong values, source_artifacts_modified=true, external_api_calls=true, and non_overwrite_policy=false. Call verify_bundle_paths with the unchanged bound queue and overlay.
reproduction.observed: verify_status=pass; all eight tampered fields were accepted.

findings.required_fix: Treat the manifest as a closed contract: require and verify the exact template path, template SHA-256, row count/order, exact generated template content, score_root, models, stage_counts, and declared safety flags before validation or finalization.

findings.title: Run and Gold paths are not frozen or contract-hashed

locations.detail: Base CONTRACT_KEYS include run_sha256 and gold_sha256 but omit run_json and gold_json paths.
The overlay contract and FROZEN_KEYS inherit the omission.
Source/bound comparison freezes only FROZEN_KEYS; later hashing accepts whichever run_json and gold_json paths are present in the bound row.

findings.impact: The same contract_sha256 can identify different evidence locations. Queue/manifest hashes can be regenerated around a relocated path while source-contract provenance remains unchanged, so the claimed path-plus-hash provenance is not actually enforced.

reproduction.method: Copy the first run JSON bytes to a different temporary path, replace only row 1 run_json in a temporary bound queue, leave row 1 contract_sha256 unchanged, update only manifest.queue and manifest.queue_sha256, then call verify_bundle_paths.

findings.required_fix: Include normalized repository-relative run_json and gold_json paths in the versioned contract, freeze them against the source queue, and reject paths outside the expected result/Gold roots.

findings.title: Overlay validation does not establish authoritative status or source-queue scope

locations.detail: validate_overlay checks only schema_version, pid_identity_scored=false, the superseded sentence, and action=operation.
bind_overlay validates the source queue and overlay separately but never cross-checks overlay.scope against that source queue.

findings.impact: A draft, non-authoritative, wrong-score-root, wrong-source-queue, wrong-row-count overlay with the four accepted tokens can be bound into a new queue as if authoritative. Overlay evidence hashes and retroactive-adoption prohibition are also not checked.

reproduction.method: Copy the overlay inside the repository, set status=draft, scope.source_queue to an unrelated path, scope.source_queue_sha256 to zeroes, and scope.queue_row_count to 1 while retaining the accepted schema/PID/superseded-text/alias fields. Run bind-overlay with that file and a fresh score root.
reproduction.expected_from_code: validate_overlay accepts it and bind-overlay creates a queue whose hash is bound to the wrong-scope overlay.

findings.required_fix: Validate authoritative status, scope score root/source queue/source queue SHA-256/row count, required resolution semantics, and evidence file hashes; cross-check scope directly with the source manifest and queue supplied to bind-overlay.

findings.title: Incomplete finalization exits with success

locations.detail: finalize writes an incomplete aggregate and returns normally when conflicts remain.
Only exceptions become exit code 2; a normal conflict return becomes process exit code 0.

findings.impact: Shells, schedulers, and CI can treat a 47/48 adopted result as completed formal scoring and continue with an incomplete aggregate unless every caller separately inspects complete=false.

reproduction.method: Create two valid 48-row overlay-bound synthetic reviews that differ on one Gold decision, omit review3, and invoke the CLI finalize command.

findings.compatibility_note: This matches the base scorer's historical behavior, but compatibility does not make it safe for a formal completion gate.
findings.required_fix: Return a distinct nonzero incomplete/conflict exit code, or split prepare-conflict-queue from final publication and publish the formal aggregate only when complete=true.

findings.title: Create-only publication is race-prone and non-transactional

locations.detail: ensure_new performs an existence check followed by ordinary write_text; the create is not exclusive and has a check/use race.
bind-overlay publishes queue, template, and manifest sequentially before final verification.
validate-review writes validated output before its report.

findings.impact: Concurrent writers can both pass exists() and a later write can truncate/replace the first artifact. A collision or verification error after an earlier write leaves a partial, create-only directory that blocks a clean retry and can be mistaken for a valid output set.

reproduction.method: Pre-create only formal_outputs_v2_pid_non_scoring/adopted_reviews.jsonl in a fresh temporary score root, then run finalize with two valid matching reviews.

findings.required_fix: Use exclusive creation (open mode x or O_CREAT|O_EXCL), preflight every destination, write a complete bundle in a new staging directory, verify it there, then atomically rename/publish the directory or a final completion manifest.

findings.title: Final outputs lack a finalization manifest binding reviewer input files and code

locations.detail: review files are read and semantically revalidated, but their paths and file hashes are not retained.

Rows record reviewer IDs and decision hashes, and the aggregate records the overlay hash, but no output manifest binds queue, manifest, template, reviewer files, wrapper/base code hashes, and all output hashes.

findings.impact: The adopted ledger can reproduce scoring decisions but cannot prove which immutable validated review artifacts and executable versions produced the publication.
findings.reproduction: Inspect formal output construction: no write creates a finalization manifest and no output field contains review1/review2/review3 file SHA-256.
findings.required_fix: Publish a create-only finalization manifest containing wrapper/base hashes, queue/manifest/template/overlay hashes, each validated reviewer path/hash/reviewer ID, all output hashes, completion state, and adjudication counts.

findings.title: Synthetic smoke and self-validation artifacts are not reproducible or independently bound

locations.detail: The smoke file contains summary booleans only; it has no test command, synthetic input/output paths or hashes, code hashes, timestamps, exit codes, or per-negative-test diagnostics.
verify_bundle_paths generates self-validation content but neither the bound manifest nor another trusted root records a self-validation hash.

findings.impact: The all-zero happy path and two claimed tamper rejections cannot be replayed from the artifact. The smoke does not cover template deletion/hash tampering, evidence-path relocation, incomplete-finalizer exit status, partial publication, or exclusive-create races.
findings.reproduction: Search the repository for synthetic_schema_hash_validator_finalizer_smoke_v1 or tampered_review_overlay_hash_rejected: no generator, command transcript, or test harness exists outside the summary JSON.
findings.required_fix: Add a deterministic local test harness and record code/input/output hashes plus command exit codes. Include negative tests for every binding and failure-mode gate; bind the resulting report hash in a completion manifest.

minimum_unblock_conditions: CQ-001 through CQ-005 are fixed and regression-tested.
A fresh create-only bundle version is generated with the fixed code; existing v2 artifacts are not overwritten.
The fresh verifier validates template path/hash/content, overlay authority/scope, exact evidence paths and hashes, and all manifest claims.
Conflict finalization has a machine-detectable non-success state and publication is atomic.
A reproducible synthetic negative-test report passes and is hash-bound to the fresh completion manifest.
